content: अरमति {%a.%} .²1 Not resting, active, going everywhere. .²2 Patient; महीमरमतिं दधन्विरे <ls>Rv. 10. 92. 5</ls>; अरमतिः सविता देव आगात् <ls>Rv.</ls> .{@-तिः@} {%f.%} .²1 Splendour. .²2 Readiness to serve, obedience; devotion to God, hence personified in the Vedas as a Goddess protecting the worshippers of the gods and pious works in general.
